name: IHWF World Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page runs a fully dated three-reign chain from its own vacant start: Apocalypse's founding reign ("Beginning of an Era," 18 February 2001, defeating the Godfather with the Bloody Mary), Vaughn's reign ("Reckless Behavior," 25 March 2001, a Triple Threat win over Apocalypse and the Godfather), and the Godfather's own closing reign (31 March 2001, defeating Vaughn one on one at Saturday Night Slaughter) — marked "Close" on the fed's own ledger. All three reigns are structured on this ledger, chained founding to closing.

name: IHWF Intercontinental Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page runs a fully dated three-reign chain from its own vacant start: Stevie Greene's founding reign (3 February 2001, pinning the Godfather after a Game Over), Chaos's reign ("Beginning of an Era," 18 February 2001, defeating Stevie Greene), and Trent Ulrich's own closing reign (17 March 2001, pinning Vaughn in a triple threat at SNS in Peoria) -- marked "Close" on the fed's own ledger.

name: IHWF Associate Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page runs a fully dated three-reign chain from its own vacant start: Enforcer's founding reign (27 January 2001, pinning Mullet in a four-way over Blaze and Enigma), Max Powers's reign ("Beginning of an Era," 18 February 2001, a Bat Match win over Enforcer and Mayhem), and Hellraisin Holly's own closing reign (17 March 2001, defeating Max Powers at SNS in Peoria, Illinois) -- marked "Close" on the fed's own ledger.

name: IHWF Extreme Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page runs a fully dated three-reign chain from its own vacant start: Mercenary's founding reign (27 January 2001, pinning Max Powers in a three-way over Killer K), Impulse's reign ("Beginning of an Era," 18 February 2001, a submission win over Mercenary), and Outcast's own closing reign (25 March 2001, surviving a nine-man Sanitarium Match at Reckless Behavior that included the reigning champion, Impulse) -- marked "Close" on the fed's own ledger.

name: IHWF Tag Team Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page runs a fully dated three-reign chain from its own vacant start: 187/Max Powers's founding reign ("Beginning of an Era," 18 February 2001, a three-way win over Slade/Apocalypse and Black Gunn/Godfather, with Killer K/Strife also contesting), Black Gunn/Mercenary's reign (Reckless Behavior, 25 March 2001, defeating the former champions with a Gunsmoke), and Plop & Splash's own closing reign, billed under a joined team name rather than an individually-named pairing -- the page's own two dates for that reign (25-31 March 2001) are the only reign on this belt's ledger given a full range instead of "Close," read here as the page's own last-updated snapshot rather than a declared handoff.
